text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am Satono Diamond. It's a pleasure to 
meet you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To break our family's jinx and etch a run 
that shines like a diamond into history... 
that is my dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, let's keep doing our best 
together from now on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
